description: List record IDs and deletion times for one Salesforce object and time window.

end.description: End of the deletion window, as a timezone-aware ISO 8601 datetime. Converted to UTC; Salesforce ignores seconds.
end.title: End

sobject.description: API name of the Salesforce object whose deleted records to list.
sobject.title: Sobject

start.description: Start of the deletion window, as a timezone-aware ISO 8601 datetime. Converted to UTC; Salesforce ignores seconds. Must precede end. Results are available for at most the previous 15 days.
start.title: Start

name: get_deleted_records

deletedDate.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when the record was deleted.
deletedDate.title: Deleted Date

id.description: Salesforce ID of the deleted record.
id.title: Id

deletedRecords.description: Accessible records deleted in the requested time window.
deletedRecords.title: Deleted Records

earliestDateAvailable.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp of the last physically deleted object.
earliestDateAvailable.title: Earliest Date Available

latestDateCovered.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp of the last date covered by this result.
latestDateCovered.title: Latest Date Covered
